correctness.rationale: Independently rebuilt both color classes via diagonal attacks, enumerated all independent subsets of one color, and checked matchings plus DAG acyclicity and exact signed integer critical boundaries. For n=2,4,6 the color critical cells have dimensions {0:1},{1:3},{2:14,3:3}, respectively; the latter 196 pairs on 408 augmented faces. The reduced Morse two-skeleton is simply connected; zero attaching degrees nullhomotope 3-cells by Hurewicz. The join X_n*X_n yields 14²=196, 2·14·3=84, 3²=9. No higher even n is proved.
